phase: Before first producer/API/CV execution; source-only math prediction and bytes already exposed

comparisonRules.rawRetention: Every raw value/type/null/condition/validity preserved regardless prediction; this comparison never changes output or selects a pose/width
comparisonRules.sourceMathematicalFiniteExpectations: Fixed absolute1e-9 in native luma/px units when comparing finite analytic predictions; all raw residuals retained, no post-output tuning
comparisonRules.engineeringReplay: Exact decoded raw native values and metadata, including Object.is exceptional numeric distinctions, typed constructor/order/length; only explicitly named timing fields excluded from deterministic comparison
comparisonRules.intactCapsule: Compare entire nativeAnswer objects for each matched query (not differing input/hash metadata) exactly; same declared local footprint predicts equality, any difference retained and investigated not normalized
comparisonRules.structural: Exact counts/order/null/condition/flag/typed constructors; no tolerance for structure
comparisonRules.failureMeaning: A prediction mismatch is a falsifier or a concrete engineering defect to diagnose; it is not authorization to lower tolerance, omit rows, fill unknown or promote a feature

claims: tau8 historical source diagnostic only; no calibrated threshold/physical edge or path identity/independent confidence/scientific or human acceptance. Predictions not yet measurements.
